source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, default order, first 20 of each query

rule: phone_tied: the quoted hearing item itself names telephone, phone or calls. shuts_out: an exclusion, or an inclusion requirement of hearing. other_item_names_phone (exploratory, not pre-registered): another eligibility item of the same record names phone, telephone or calls. Text cut with ... was checked against the single record; note gives the rest in brief.
